request: um can you pick up my beanie and stick it in the laundry basket
description: find the beanie, grab it, then find the laundry basket and drop it in
tree_xml:
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <IsVisible object="beanie" />
                <SearchFor object="beanie" />
            </Fallback>
            <NavigateTo target="beanie" />
            <Grab object="beanie" />
            <Fallback>
                <IsVisible object="laundry basket" />
                <SearchFor object="laundry basket" />
            </Fallback>
            <NavigateTo target="laundry basket" />
            <Release target="laundry basket" />
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>
